text: The Sindh Resilience Project – Additional Financing (SRP–AF) is an initiative aimed at enhancing resilience to natural disasters and public health emergencies in Sindh, Pakistan. It is an expansion of the parent Sindh Resilience Project, focusing on mitigating flood and drought risks and strengthening disaster and emergency management capacity. The project is implemented by the Government of Sindh and financed by the World Bank, with a focus on infrastructure for risk mitigation, systems and institutions for emergency management, and flexible financing for rapid response.
